title: Lifecycle of one SDK call
caption: From the method call to its result or error (internal/client.js, session.js, http.js). Retries happen only for the retry classes safe and idempotent, at most maxRetries (default 2) times; a call is sent again after TOKEN_EXPIRED or CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID at most once, with the same Idempotency-Key, except the airline-card completion.

states.label: options and params validated
states.detail: Unknown or invalid option (an `Idempotency-Key` header outside 16–128 visible ASCII included), missing path param, `.`/`..` path param or `request()` path segment, missing `ifMatch`, cookie-mode token → `TypeError` before any request.

states.label: fetching CSRF cookie (cookie mode, writes)
states.detail: `GET /v1/storefront` with `cache: no-store`, shared by concurrent writes of the family.

states.label: attempt in flight
states.detail: Timeout per attempt (body included): call `timeoutMs`, else route-table value (60 s / 90 s), else client (30 s).

states.label: back-off / Retry-After wait
states.detail: 0.5 s × 2^(n-1), max 8 s, ± 20 %; `Retry-After` replaces it; > 30 s ends the call. The signal's abort ends the wait.

states.label: waiting for the session refresh
states.detail: After `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`: joins the family's refresh in flight or starts one; skipped when the session already moved on.

states.label: rejected: mapped API error
states.detail: ValidationError, AuthenticationError, PermissionError, NotFoundError, ConflictError (PriceChanged, SoldOut), ExpiredError, PaymentError, RateLimitError, SupplierError, ServerError, or plain VelexisError (412, 423).

states.label: rejected: ConnectionError
states.detail: `NETWORK_ERROR` (a rejected `fetch`, after retries), `TIMEOUT` (never retried), `ABORTED` (never retried); status 0. A custom `fetch` that throws synchronously is no ConnectionError: its error is rethrown as it is, at once.

transitions.label: 429 / 503 / 504 / network error, retry class safe|idempotent, budget left
refresh refused 401 → onSessionExpired; or airline card (never resent)
other 4xx/5xx, budget spent, or Retry-After > 30 s
timeout / abort / network error with no budget
